info.title: Window
info.description: Provides key interception capabilities for web-based apps. Apps can register to receive specific key events even when not in focus, as long as they are in the Active lifecycle state.

methods.name: Window.addKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Adds the supplied list of keys to the set of keys that are received by this app when it is in the Active lifecycle state but not in focus. The key is represented by the JS event.key attribute defined in the Firebolt Key Codes Specification. No-op if a key is already in the intercept set. Validation is performed by the server, not the client library. Returns an error if called when the app is not in the Active lifecycle state.

params.name: keys
params.description: List of one or more key identifiers, unordered

methods.name: Window.removeKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Removes the supplied list of keys from the set of keys that are received by this app when it is in the Active lifecycle state but not in focus. The key is represented by the JS event.key attribute defined in the Firebolt Key Codes Specification. No-op if a key is not in the intercept set. Validation is performed by the server, not the client library. Returns an error if called when the app is not in the Active lifecycle state.

params.name: keys
params.description: List of one or more key identifiers, unordered
